title: Detroit, MI — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Detroit, MI: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Detroit is a city in MI with a population of 632,464. Motor City is rebuilding with incredibly cheap housing, a growing arts scene, and Motown soul. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
